title: Little to no steam
text:
Little to no steam. This floor steamer was easy to assemble & is extremely light weight. The swivel head makes it easy to maneuver.
The product does not produce much steam. There is no trigger, so to operate, you push down on the handle. After letting the unit heat up for 15 min, I was expecting bursts of steam. Nope - barely any steam & if you give the handle a 2nd push - nothing. You then have to wait for some more steam to build up. At this rate, it would take an hour to steam mop a small bathroom.
Sorry, but I cannot recommend this product.
